author: Rusty McMurray / Soulshine; built by Claude at his direction
preserves: v1.1, v1.2, v1.3, v1.4 (receipt f20e86ae...34a8). world.py and v1_readers.py byte-identical to v1.
direction: Rusty, 2026-10-15: 'record of wrongs' is error tracking, not learning. No penalty of past error, but knowledge of the error, for future consideration and growth when needed.

rule.unchanged: fresh full look at every need (v1.3/v1.4). Every reading is deposited into the question's RECORD and is never deleted.
rule.no_penalty: OPERATIONALIZATION BY CLAUDE, flagged: a reading weighs on the present only while the terrain it read is still the present terrain, i.e. while it was taken within the current look's span (day >= d - 41). Older readings stay in the record as knowledge but carry no weight in the crossing. No new parameter: 'present' is the look's own 42-day span.
rule.crossing: PROPOSE at a look when the sum of +1 (reads change) and -1 (reads not-yet) over readings in the present span, including this one, is > 0. Otherwise HELD.

experiments: as v1.4: lambda 32, 128, 8 x 6 families x 300 seeds; probe; BURST b = 5, 8; v1.4 and v1.2 run alongside on identical worlds.

predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.V2_genuine: GENUINE >= 173 at lambda 32 (v1.2) and >= 240 at lambda 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.V3_positional_confounds: COMMUTE <= 5 and DINNER <= 5 at lambda 32 and 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.V4_difficult_month: WINDOW <= 28 at lambda 32 and <= 78 at lambda 128 (v1.2).
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.V6_action: macro accuracy >= 0.8516 at lambda 32 and >= 0.8836 at lambda 128 (v1.2).
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.V7_information_limit: COLOCATED vs GENUINE |z| < 3 at lambda 32 and 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.V8_cost: MAIN mean region evaluations <= 0.25 x v1 TERRAIN's.

reporting_rule: PASS/FAIL as frozen with exact counts. No change after the first full run.
